name: bridge-recon
description: Palm <-> Ethereum ChainBridge reconciliation: daily CI fetch, git-as-database, static dashboard

scripts.import: node bridge-db.js import palm && node bridge-db.js import ethereum
scripts.sync: node bridge-db.js import palm && node bridge-db.js import ethereum && node bridge-db.js fetch palm && node bridge-db.js fetch ethereum && node bridge-db.js export && node bridge-db.js reconcile --json
